name: censof-mcp
description: Read-only search over the GRP knowledge base: 101,530 closed RFS support tickets, Acumatica documentation, and the GRP manuals. Bundles the rfs-analyze skill, which diagnoses one ticket end to end — reads its attachments, finds precedent in the closed-ticket history, cross-checks the documentation, and proposes a fix labelled proven, proposed, or a workaround over an unfixed root cause. Needs CENSOF_MCP_TOKEN set to your personal grpkb_ token.
